newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers sag in afternoon, elsewhere steady.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers sag in afternoon, elsewhere steady.

text.p: Fuel oil bunker prices in Rotterdam sagged in thin afternoon trading on Wednesday, while other areas were steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was offered as low as $87.50/$88 fob as the barge market came off from its steady start trading at $85 ex wharf a couple of times. Two trading houses were the sellers.
Total ARA bunker demand was little more than 10,000 tonnes, according to most suppliers questioned.
Hamburg bunkers were unchanged. Demand was poor.
Prices in the Mediterranean barely moved.
Demand was also weak in all areas.

Saudi Aramco cut prices for both fuel oil and diesel in all ports. Red Sea fuel oil came down $2 to $98.50 and diesel fell by $10 to $179. Gulf fuel oil was down $2 to $102, while diesel was cut $3 to $206. The prices take effect on Thursday.
